text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Thursday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- A 20-year-old border guard was accidently shot dead by another guard during a drinking bout at a post in southern Lithuania.
- Lithuanian Energy mulls Eurobond issue next year to boost its working capital.
- The finance ministry launched a tender for a manager to arrange a $100 million syndicated loan.
- Lithuania's foreign debt was 5.068 billion litas at the end of June, an increase of 369.2 million litas during the first half of 1997.
- The prosecutor's office has charged three young men suspected of robbing and savagely beating a French diplomat on Sunday.
- Social Democtrats opposed to the privatisation of several key state assets say they have collected half of the petitions needed to hold a referendum on the issue.
- Two-thirds of Lithuania's working population have jobs in private sector.
- A law on refugees will come into force on July 27. Forty-two people have applied for refugee status in the country.
- Prosecutor general Kazys Pednychia suspects that a recent spate of attacks against foreigners might be inspired by forces which want to damage the country's image.
